title: Wa Hussaina Shaheede Karbala
body:
Wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Din dhala asr ka jab Shaam hui, kya udaasi thi haram par chaayi, bhaiyi ki laash pa Zainab ne kaha, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
Ab na Qasim na Ali Akbar, ab na Abbas na ab Asghar hai, na raha koi bhi Abid ke siwa, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
Roke zindaan mein Sakina ne kaha, dam ghoota jata aoo baba, kyon nahi sunte ho tum meri sada, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
Bhayi be goro kafan maqtal mein, be ride sheh ki bahen maqtal mein, cheenli shumre sitamgar ne rida, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
Hurmula tu ne ajab ki hai jafa, haye wo teer wo Asghar ka gala, inteha ye hai ke jhoola bhi jala, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
Zulm ye Abid-e-muztar pa hua, taoq gardan main wo durro ki jafa, tha magar lab faqat shukre khuda
<<MINI>>
Wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Leke parwana e Qasim parcham, quld mein jayenge karte matam, aur ankhon mein liye ashke aza
<<MINI>>
Wa hussaina shaheede Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye ye kaisi udaasi hai sohail, aankh fitrat ki bhari ayi hai sohail, haye kya aap ne nouha ye likha, wa hussaina shaheede Karbala..
